description: This file is a script for checking that documentation files have corresponding entries in a Chinese glossary JSON file. It reads documentation files, extracts glossary terms based on specific patterns, and compares them with an existing glossary to identify missing entries, aiding internationalization efforts.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for base and head git references.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command in the repository root and returns its output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the common merge base for comparisons, using explicit argument, environment variable, or default branches.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists documentation files that have changed compared to a specified base branch.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads the list of glossary source entries from the JSON file.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks if a given text contains Latin alphabet characters.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a given text.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a scalar string if present.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term is a suitable glossary candidate based on content constraints.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Reads the content of a file as it exists in a specified git base.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Extracts glossary terms from a markdown or mdx file based on specific patterns.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that coordinates the process of identifying missing glossary entries for changed documentation files.
